aboutText: With over 25 years of experience, Top Edge Kitchens & Bathroom Renovations has been the go-to choice for home renovations in Deer Park. We offer free consultations and comprehensive project management, ensuring every detail from demolition to installation is handled by qualified trades. Our services include gas, electrical, plumbing work, and structural modifications, all backed by a 7 Year HIA Guarantee for complete peace of mind.
servicesText: We specialise in kitchen and bathroom renovations, providing end-to-end solutions tailored to your needs. From initial design to final touches, our team ensures a seamless renovation experience in Deer Park and surrounds.
